canonical_example.text: Usa alcohol puro para borrar el marcador permanente.
canonical_example.translation: Use pure alcohol to remove permanent marker.

canonical_example.text: ¿Dijo que yo le robé dinero? Son puras mentiras.
canonical_example.translation: He said I stole his money? That's just lies.

canonical_example.text: Mi padre siempre fuma puros habanos cuando juega al póquer.
canonical_example.translation: My father always smokes Cuban cigars when he is playing poker.

canonical_example.text: Este anillo de oro puro cuesta un medio millón de dólares.
canonical_example.translation: This solid gold ring costs half a million dollars.

canonical_example.text: Necesito irme de la ciudad para respirar aire puro.
canonical_example.translation: I need to leave the city to breathe clean air.

canonical_example.text: Encontré la billetera que perdiste de pura casualidad.
canonical_example.translation: I've found the wallet you lost by pure chance.

canonical_example.text: Gritó a todos en el cuarto de pura rabia.
canonical_example.translation: She screamed at everyone in the room out of sheer rage.

canonical_example.text: Dice que solo se va a casar con una mujer que sea pura.
canonical_example.translation: He says he will only get married to a woman who is pure.

canonical_example.text: El sacerdote cree que solamente un hombre y una mujer puros pueden experimentar el amor verdadero.
canonical_example.translation: The priest believes only chaste men and women can experience true love.

canonical_example.text: Mi amigo de Ghana cree que en los Estados Unidos hay puros ricos.
canonical_example.translation: My friend from Ghana believes that there are only rich people in the United States.

canonical_example.text: Me metieron un puro por fumar en el baño.
canonical_example.translation: They threw the book at me for smoking in the bathroom.

canonical_example.text: Este es el primer concursante que queda eliminado del programa.
canonical_example.translation: This is the first contestant to be out of the show.

canonical_example.text: Me cayó salsa en la blusa y no he podido eliminar la mancha.
canonical_example.translation: I spilled sauce on my blouse and I have not been able to remove the stain.

canonical_example.text: Solo quedan un par de obstáculos que eliminar para llegar a nuestra meta.
canonical_example.translation: There are only a couple of obstacles left to eliminate so we can reach our goal.

canonical_example.text: El jefe de la mafia dio la orden de eliminar al soplón.
canonical_example.translation: The mafia boss gave the order to eliminate the snitch.

canonical_example.text: El equipo visitante nos eliminó del torneo.
canonical_example.translation: The visiting team eliminated us from the tournament.

canonical_example.text: Para el examen de ecuaciones, sigan los pasos para eliminar la variable.
canonical_example.translation: For the equation test, please follow the steps to eliminate the variable.

canonical_example.text: Algunos países en desarrollo han creado modelos eficientes para eliminar el analfabetismo.
canonical_example.translation: Several developing countries have created effective models to get rid of illiteracy.

canonical_example.text: ¿Sabes cuál es el mejor método para eliminar ratones?
canonical_example.translation: Do you know which is the best method to get rid of mice?

canonical_example.text: El clavadista olímpico fue eliminado en la segunda vuelta.
canonical_example.translation: The olympic diver was knocked out in the second round.

canonical_example.text: Tomar agua caliente con limón ayuda a eliminar toxinas
canonical_example.translation: Drinking hot water with lemon helps you eliminate toxins.

canonical_example.text: Teníamos una lista larga de candidatos, pero se eliminaron muchos después de las entrevistas.
canonical_example.translation: We had a long list of candidates, but many were eliminated after the interviews.

canonical_example.text: Si no me necesitan aquí, permiso y me elimino.
canonical_example.translation: If you don't need me here, with your permission, I'll go away.

canonical_example.text: Estaban rodeados por el enemigo y tuvieron que rendirse.
canonical_example.translation: They were surrounded by the enemy and had to surrender.

canonical_example.text: Nos vimos rodeados por la multitud.
canonical_example.translation: We felt encircled by the crowd.

canonical_example.text: Rodea el número correcto con lápiz o esfero.
canonical_example.translation: Circle the correct number with a pencil or pen.

canonical_example.text: Se rodeó de su familia antes de fallecer.
canonical_example.translation: He surrounded himself with his family before passing away.

canonical_example.text: El perro rodeó el ganado en el corral.
canonical_example.translation: The dog rounded up the cattle in the pen.

canonical_example.text: Esperemos que la respuesta sea afirmativa y podamos seguir adelante con el plan.
canonical_example.translation: Let's hope we get an affirmative reply so we can go ahead with the plan.

canonical_example.text: No esperaba una respuesta afirmativa de mi jefe cuando le pedí el aumento.
canonical_example.translation: I didn't expect my boss to give me a positive answer when I asked for a pay rise.

canonical_example.text: ¿Vendrás al concierto el día 5? - ¡Afirmativo!
canonical_example.translation: Will you come to the concert on the 5th? - Affirmative!

canonical_example.text: Tomé cuatro materias este semestre.
canonical_example.translation: I took four courses this semester.

canonical_example.text: Reprobé la física el semestre pasado.
canonical_example.translation: I flunked physics last term.

canonical_example.text: El inquilino me paga por semestres.
canonical_example.translation: My tenant pays me every six months.

canonical_example.text: Se prevé un ligero repunte económico para el segundo semestre del año.
canonical_example.translation: A slight economic upturn is predicted for the second half of the year.

canonical_example.text: Trabajé un semestre en la fábrica de plástico.
canonical_example.translation: I worked a half-year at the plastic factory.

canonical_example.text: Mi fiesta de cumpleaños es el sábado que viene. ¡Avísame si vas a venir!
canonical_example.translation: My birthday party is next Saturday. Let me know if you're coming!

canonical_example.text: Hay que avisar al gobierno local antes de abrir un negocio.
canonical_example.translation: You must notify the local government before opening a business.

canonical_example.text: Asegúrate de avisar al médico acerca de los medicamentos que tomas.
canonical_example.translation: Be sure to tell the doctor about the medications you're taking.

canonical_example.text: La sirena sonó para avisarles a todos que venía un tornado.
canonical_example.translation: The siren sounded to warn everyone that a tornado was coming.

canonical_example.text: Hay que avisar a la escuela de que van a llegar tarde.
canonical_example.translation: We need to call the school to let them know they'll be late.

canonical_example.text: Mi hermana gemela me viene a visitar mañana.
canonical_example.translation: My twin sister is coming to visit tomorrow.

canonical_example.text: Los gemelos llegaron de visita de San José.
canonical_example.translation: The twins came to visit from San Jose.

canonical_example.text: Marcos y Martín son mellizos; no son gemelos.
canonical_example.translation: Marcos and Martin are fraternal twins; they aren't identical twins.

canonical_example.text: Me lastimé el gemelo porque salí a correr sin calentar primero.
canonical_example.translation: I injured my calf muscle, because I went out running without warming up first.

canonical_example.text: Le regalé unos gemelos a mi padre para su camisa de vestir.
canonical_example.translation: I gave my dad some cuff links for his dress shirt.

canonical_example.text: Pásame los gemelos para ver mejor aquel elefante.
canonical_example.translation: Hand me the binoculars so I can see that elephant better.

canonical_example.text: Siempre me llevo los gemelos al teatro para poder ver las expresiones en las caras de los actores.
canonical_example.translation: I always bring my opera glasses to the theater so I can see the expressions on the actors' faces.

canonical_example.text: ¿Cómo resultaron las elecciones de hoy?
canonical_example.translation: How did today's elections turn out?

canonical_example.text: El viaje a Honduras resultó más interesante de lo que esperaba.
canonical_example.translation: The trip to Honduras turned out to be more interesting than I had imagined.

canonical_example.text: El ciclista resultó gravemente herido en el choque.
canonical_example.translation: The cyclist was seriously injured in the crash.

canonical_example.text: El incendio forestal resultó ser muy dañino.
canonical_example.translation: The forest fire proved to be very harmful.

canonical_example.text: Quiso intentar una receta nueva pero no le resultó.
canonical_example.translation: He wanted to try out a new recipe but it didn't work.

canonical_example.text: A ver si esta vez le resulta.
canonical_example.translation: Let's see if it works out for him this time.

canonical_example.text: Por fortuna, todo resultó bien en la fiesta.
canonical_example.translation: Fortunately, everything worked out well at the party.

canonical_example.text: Me resultó muy interesante la plática del profesor.
canonical_example.translation: I found the professor's talk very interesting.

canonical_example.text: Algo bueno tiene que resultar de tus esfuerzos.
canonical_example.translation: Something good has to come of your efforts.

canonical_example.text: El éxito del presidente resulta de años de trabajo duro.
canonical_example.translation: The president's success is the result of years of hard work.

canonical_example.text: La riña entre los políticos resultó en un deterioro de los servicios prestados al pueblo.
canonical_example.translation: The quarrel between the politicians resulted in a decline of services to the people.

canonical_example.text: Comer mucha sal podría resultar en hipertensión.
canonical_example.translation: Eating a lot of salt may lead to hypertension.

canonical_example.text: El cirujano puede solucionar cualquier complicación que surja durante la operación.
canonical_example.translation: The surgeon can address any complications that may arise during surgery.

canonical_example.text: Si surgiera algún problema mientras estamos fuera, llámanos de inmediato.
canonical_example.translation: If a problem were to come up while we are away, call us immediately.

canonical_example.text: De nuestra discusión de la tarde surgieron varias ideas buenas.
canonical_example.translation: Several good ideas emerged from our afternoon discussion.

canonical_example.text: El carro surgió de la nada y no me dio tiempo de girar para evitarlo.
canonical_example.translation: The car appeared out of nowhere and I didn't have time to swerve to avoid it.

canonical_example.text: Cuando la perforadora perforó la tierra, surgió una corriente constante de agua.
canonical_example.translation: When the drilling machine pierced the earth, a steady stream of water sprang forth.

canonical_example.text: Yo adoro a mi nuera.
canonical_example.translation: I adore my daughter-in-law.

canonical_example.text: Los griegos antiguos eran politeístas y adoraban a dioses como Zeus y Apolo.
canonical_example.translation: The Ancient Greeks were polytheists who worshiped gods like Zeus and Apollo.

canonical_example.text: Se negó a renegar de su fe y adorar ídolos falsos.
canonical_example.translation: He refused to renounce his faith and adore false idols.

canonical_example.text: La mujer empezó a llorar y no sabíamos cómo consolarla.
canonical_example.translation: The woman started crying and we didn't know how to comfort her.

canonical_example.text: Todos lloraban en el funeral.
canonical_example.translation: Everyone was weeping at the funeral.

canonical_example.text: Lloramos su muerte cada día.
canonical_example.translation: We mourn his passing every day.

canonical_example.text: No te entiendo cuando estás llorando. ¡Háblame bien!
canonical_example.translation: I don't know what you're saying when you're whining. Speak properly!

canonical_example.text: Llórale un poquito a la abuela a ver si te paga el viaje.
canonical_example.translation: Why don't you go and moan to your grandma and see if she'll pay for the trip.

canonical_example.text: Me lloran los ojos si hay demasiada luz.
canonical_example.translation: My eyes water when it's too bright.

canonical_example.text: "Perdí mi peluche", dijo la niñita mientras lloraba lágrimas amargas.
canonical_example.translation: "I lost my teddy," said the little girl while she cried bitter tears.

canonical_example.text: Solo quedan dos episodios para que termine la temporada.
canonical_example.translation: There are only two episodes left before the season ends.

canonical_example.translation: She's a reliable friend; you can always count on her.

canonical_example.text: No siendo expertos en temas bancarios, lo mejor es que elijamos un banco confiable.

canonical_example.translation: Carlos scored the first goal of the game.

canonical_example.text: Llevamos alimentos a personas que viven encerradas en sus casas por edad o enfermedad.
canonical_example.translation: We deliver meals to people who are shut in at home due to age or illnesses.

canonical_example.text: Estudió una carrera mientras estuvo encerrado en la cárcel.
canonical_example.translation: He completed his degree while he was locked up in jail.

canonical_example.text: Se dañó la chapa de la puerta y nos quedamos encerrados hasta que llegó el cerrajero.
canonical_example.translation: The doorknob broke, and we were locked in until the locksmith came.

canonical_example.text: No es sano que estés siempre encerrado en este cuarto. ¡Necesitas salir al aire libre!
canonical_example.translation: It's unhealthy to be shut up in this room all the time. You need some fresh air!

canonical_example.text: Esos monjes viven encerrados en su convento, apartados del resto del mundo.
canonical_example.translation: Those monks live shut away in their monastery, keeping apart from the rest of the world.

canonical_example.text: Al ganado encerrado en este corral se le permite salir a pastar todos los días.
canonical_example.translation: The cattle enclosed in this pen are allowed to roam and graze every day.

canonical_example.text: Saco al perro tres veces al día.
canonical_example.translation: I walk the dog three times a day.

canonical_example.text: La perra tuvo cinco cachorros.
canonical_example.translation: The bitch had five puppies.

canonical_example.text: Esa perra se llevó todas mis cosas mientras estaba en el trabajo.
canonical_example.translation: That bitch took all my stuff while I was at work.

canonical_example.text: Todos sus exnovios eran perros de verdad.
canonical_example.translation: All of her ex-boyfriends were total pigs.

canonical_example.text: Es un perro. No busca una relación.
canonical_example.translation: He's a womanizer. He's not looking for a relationship.

canonical_example.text: Ese perro se acostó con cinco de mis amigas.
canonical_example.translation: That player slept with five of my friends.

canonical_example.text: Ha tenido una vida perra, pero no por eso se puede desquitar con todo el mundo.
canonical_example.translation: He's had a lousy life, but that doesn't mean he can take it out on everyone else.

canonical_example.text: Estuvo súper perro el examen. Nadie lo pudo pasar.
canonical_example.translation: The exam was super difficult. Nobody was able to pass it.

canonical_example.text: Esa señora es bien perra. Siempre se sale con la suya.
canonical_example.translation: That lady is so cunning. She always gets what she wants.

canonical_example.text: Esos policías perros nos pidieron una mordida.
canonical_example.translation: Those lowlife cops asked us for a bribe.

canonical_example.text: No puedo acompañarte al cine. Apenas tengo una perra.
canonical_example.translation: I can't go with you to the movies. I haven't got a penny.

canonical_example.text: Préstame unas perras. Quiero jugar a las tragaperras.
canonical_example.translation: Lend me some coins. I want to play the slot machines.

canonical_example.text: El chico cogió una perra cuando le dijeron que no le iban a comprar un helado.
canonical_example.translation: The boy threw a tantrum when they told him they weren't going to buy him an ice cream.

canonical_example.text: Me ha dado la perra de escuchar la canción nueva de mi artista favorita toda la tarde.
canonical_example.translation: I was overcome by an obsession to listen to my favorite singer's new song all afternoon.

canonical_example.text: Esa perra intentó besar a mi novio.
canonical_example.translation: That slut was tried to kiss my boyfriend.
